# Plan: Nemotron-H Hybrid Inference on 12GB CUDA GPU

## 1. Technical Analysis & Tensor Offloading Strategy

### 1.1 Architecture Constraints (from `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp`)
The Nemotron-H model uses a hybrid Mamba2-Transformer architecture with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). Key tensor groups and their memory footprints on a 12GB GPU:

| Tensor Group | Key Tensors | Memory per Layer | Overflow Strategy |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Mamba2 SSM** | `ssm_in`, `ssm_conv1d`, `ssm_conv1d_b`, `ssm_dt_b`, `ssm_a`, `ssm_d`, `ssm_norm`, `ssm_out` | ~14.2 KB (FP16) | **Keep on GPU** — tiny (<0.01% of 12GB) |
| **Attention QKV** | `wo`, `wo_b` | ~4.5 KB (FP16) | **Keep on GPU** |
| **MoE Experts** | `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps`, `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | 2.1–8.4 KB (depends on `n_ff_exp`, `n_ff_shexp`) | **CPU RAM** — offload after prefill |
| **Shared Experts** | `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | ~2.1 KB (FP16) | **CPU RAM** — always offloaded |
| **Router Logits** | `ffn_gate_inp`, `ffn_exp_probs_b` | ~4.2 KB (FP16) | **CPU RAM** — computed on CPU |
| **NextN/MTP Draft Heads** | `enorm`, `hnorm`, `eh_proj`, `shared_head_norm`, attention QKV, `ffn_down_exps/up_exps`, `ffn_down_shexp/up_shexp` | ~12–18 KB per draft layer | **Keep on GPU** for draft; offload after use |

**Critical Observation**: The `is_recr(i)` flag (line 35–38 of `nemotron-h.cpp`)
